title: Best app ever
body: This is the app I use daily. Keeps me organised and not forgetting the important stuff. Can you guys pls also add a “Year-goal” value? Right now the “Custom” one can only get to up to 100 days. This would make the app 10/5
author: deppy_jo

title: Great app
body: The app is really useful and the support team is the best!!!
author: Yo54223

title: Amazing work!
body: Great app! As a person that aesthetics help me a lot to be productive I have to say - it’s difficult to find a habit application with such good UI. I’d love to wait on you guys for some practical enhancements regarding customization of habits ( sorting based on groups when seeing all habits without completely removing the rest from the screen, adding checklists within one habit and maybe introducing a “to-do” page for one time tasks. Another amazing addition would be to be able to customize notifications more - eg. select tue at 17.00 instead of getting it everyday at 17 if it’s a daily habit to be completed X times a week) Hope this makes sense! Keep up the good work guys!! 🖤
author: Dimitra H

title: Perfect but there is always room for improvement
body: What can anyone say against this app? Maybe the best free-to-use habit tracker and that comes out of experience with other apps. My only suggestion for a minor improvement would be to add a function that can reset your data and start fresh. That could be integrated by allowing the change of the start date of any habit. Maybe it is supposed to work like this but on my phone after a habit setup is way past its start date, it is not possible to tweak it.

body: I have used many habit tracker apps and this is by far the best of them. It offers many options to set your habits, the stats are great, the ui is easy to use. I highly recommend it.

title: Nice features
body: I have the app mainly because you can one-tap your habits through the interactive widget. The only thing that needs to be fixed, and i need a developer response here, is why you cant one-tap habits partially. I mean if you have a goal of count 2 or 3 for the week you must open the app now when you tap the widget. What would be ideal is to highlight a half or one third of the circle of the completed habit shown in the widgets. Thanks in advance

title: Amazing app, but glitchy
body: I love this app, it is exactly what I was looking for, would recommend 100%. But I had a habit for more than a month, and today I open the app to check it off and it’s just nowhere to be found. So sad that I lost all of my stats, it would be cool if you could alter the values of previous days on a nearly created habit, if that makes any sense
